_comment: Task 2b held-out probe probe_indoor_env_v2: indoor built-environment negatives the model has never seen, never entering training. Used after phase two to test whether the indoor false-trigger fix generalises to unseen scene types.
_role: PROBE ONLY. Downloaded to data/probe_indoor_env_v2, outside data/raw, so prepare_dataset does not ingest it and it never enters the training pool.
_design: Deliberately chosen to share the causal confounders of the diagnosed FP scenes (office, meeting, living room): indoors, walls, windows, rectangular furniture, possibly switched-off screens. But the scene types are different (lobby, library, lounge, reception, waiting area), which makes it a generalisation probe. Weighted toward furniture and architecture.
_zero_overlap: After downloading, run the guard check against the training pool (data/raw) and both existing probes: zero ID collisions and zero perceptual near-duplicates. Anything that hits is quarantined.
